WIP functions for handling GPS data as part of the SEATRACK project.

Documentation at <https://ninanor.github.io/seatrack-gps/>

# Package index

## All functions

- [`get_diagnostics()`](https://ninanor.github.io/seatrack-gps/reference/get_diagnostics.md)
  : Get diagnostics from position data
- [`get_tag_files()`](https://ninanor.github.io/seatrack-gps/reference/get_tag_files.md)
  : Get all files for a specific tag
- [`load_all_gps_data()`](https://ninanor.github.io/seatrack-gps/reference/load_all_gps_data.md)
  : Read all data from an archive or folder
- [`load_tag_acc_data()`](https://ninanor.github.io/seatrack-gps/reference/load_tag_acc_data.md)
  : Load acceleration data for a specific tag
- [`load_tag_pos_data()`](https://ninanor.github.io/seatrack-gps/reference/load_tag_pos_data.md)
  : Load position data for a specific tag
- [`open_gps_data_files()`](https://ninanor.github.io/seatrack-gps/reference/open_gps_data_files.md)
  : Find all compatible GPS data files in a directory structure
- [`read_acc_data()`](https://ninanor.github.io/seatrack-gps/reference/read_acc_data.md)
  : Get acceleration data from a file connection
- [`read_pos_data()`](https://ninanor.github.io/seatrack-gps/reference/read_pos_data.md)
  : Get position data from a specific tag file
